title: Luminescent-reaction-enabled super-resolution imaging.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed the Zenodo record (CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY is an open licence): three raw image stacks, ECL_Fig2h.tif (39.3 MB), CL_Fig4b.tif (42.0 MB) and BL_Fig4i.tif (40.1 MB), plus 'Data Condition.txt' (439 bytes) and RIED Code.zip (9.2 MB). I read Data Condition.txt: each stack is one representative acquisition for one figure panel (pixel size 160 nm, exposure 20/1000/500 ms, EM gain 500). I did not download the TIFF stacks.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That these are electrochemiluminescence (ECL), chemiluminescence (CL) and bioluminescence (BL) movies of organelles, that the method reaches about 100 nm resolution, and that the remaining data are 'available from the corresponding author on request'. The supplementary file listing timed out and was not retrieved.

a1_downloadable.note: Three representative raw stacks and code download openly from Zenodo (checked listing); everything else is 'on request', per the paper.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked the files: there is no label of any kind, only three unannotated raw image stacks. Any target (for example a super-resolved image) would have to be produced by running the paper's own reconstruction.

a3_inputs_present.note: Raw image frames are present as TIFF stacks (seen in the listing, not opened).

a4_units_stated.note: Data Condition.txt states pixel size 160 nm, exposure time and EM (electron-multiplying) gain for each stack.

a5_enough_rows.note: Three acquisitions in total, one per imaging modality (checked listing). Far below any usable count.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Three stacks of about 40 MB each.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Paper says 'representative raw data'; three files on Zenodo match that description.

a8_label_provenance.note: The only derivable target would be the RIED reconstruction (the paper's algorithm output) computed from the same frames: circular by construction.

honest_claim_h3: With three unlabelled image stacks, no model claim is possible; at most one could reproduce the paper's reconstruction on its own demo data.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use raw low-light chemically-lit microscope movies to predict sharper, super-resolved images of cell organelles.
plain_idea.train_on: Raw frame stacks from light-free (chemical or electrochemical) luminescence microscopy; 3 stacks available publicly (verified).
plain_idea.predict: A super-resolved image; the only 'truth' available is the paper's own reconstruction algorithm output, not an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: A learned reconstruction could cut the photon budget needed for light-free live-cell imaging, but this deposit is far too small to train or test one.

ml_idea: Learned denoising/super-resolution of reaction-driven luminescence movies; not feasible on 3 representative stacks with no independent ground truth.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A on file listing.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count deposited acquisitions on Zenodo: 3 (done, kills it).

verdict_reason: Zenodo holds only three unlabelled representative image stacks (one per modality); the rest is on request, and the only possible target is the paper's own algorithm output (A2, A5, A8 fail).
